usage: agentless-mcp diagram [-h] [--repo PATH] [--json] [--no-cache]

  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

                        current directory)
  --json                emit JSON instead of text
  --no-cache            parse on demand and ignore the tag cache for this call
  --focus FILE_OR_SYMBOL
                        draw only this module's neighbourhood, resolved like
                        map --focus
  --max-nodes MAX_NODES
                        modules drawn (default: 40); the rest are announced on
                        an explicit elision node
  --max-edges MAX_EDGES
                        arrows drawn (default: 40); reference edges past this
                        bound are announced in a comment rather than drawn
  --communities         group the modules into community subgraphs
  --resolution RESOLUTION
                        modularity resolution used by --communities
  --check FILE          regenerate and compare against FILE instead of
                        printing; exit 0 when identical, 1 when it has
                        drifted. A leading ```mermaid fence is stripped before
                        comparing, so a committed .md diagram can be checked
                        as it stands
